observation.instruction:
Stack the blocks bottom-up: red block, then green block, then blue block.
Completion requirements: Use verified tactile state and fresh images. Complete every named object. For placement, release and retreat to inspect the final arrangement. For lifting, presenting or scanning, retain the required objects; do not release them merely to end the task. Build a single vertical tower in the specified bottom-to-top colour order. Place each block centred on the preceding block and release.
